main.content:
[[Nevermore I: Ravenswood Branch]] is a [[Legendary Weapons]] [[collection]] [[achievement]] to gain the [[precursor weapon]], [[The Raven Staff]], for the [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[staff]], [[Nevermore]]. This collection is the first step to obtain the first tier of the precursor, [[Ravenswood Branch]].

== Achievement ==
{{achievement box}}

=== Collection items ===
{{collection table}}

== Notes ==
* Most of the items are rewards from various events but three (3) are purchased for a total of 5,544 {{Karma}} from various event or heart vendors.
* All Trophies from this collection can be safely destroyed upon acquiring them.

== Related collections ==
* [[Nevermore II: Ravenswood Staff]]
* [[Nevermore III: The Raven Staff]]
* [[Nevermore IV: The Raven Spirit]]
